title: Simple Bouguer anomaly map of the Cokesbury quadrangle
citation: Chalcraft, R.G., Lawrence, D.P., Horrocks, Steven, Downs, Douglas, and Velgus, Margaret, 1979, Simple Bouguer anomaly map of the Cokesbury quadrangle: South Carolina Geological Survey Open-File Report OFR-22, map scale 1:24,000.
notes: SCGS OFR-22 (Chalcraft and others, 1979): simple Bouguer anomaly map of the Cokesbury 7.5-minute quadrangle on the topographic base, with gravity contours at one milligal and numbered gravity stations. The sheet shows no geologic units, structures, drill holes or geologic surfaces; gravity contours and station values are geophysical and do not fit the schema, so nothing is recorded (same treatment as other single-sheet Bouguer maps). SUBSURFACE: none.
